limits: Derived from provided production records and actual cut contact sheet. Root did not replay the complete video or query live model capabilities. These descriptors do not prove future media quality.

cases.symptom: Old failure clip not evidenced; a demonstrative pronoun may be bound to a later communication socket.
cases.treatment: Check source occurrence and adopted failure/target coverage before next decision; no invented explanation or early reveal.
cases.acceptance: Actual adopted scene makes specified failure aftermath and pronoun target readable.
cases.stop: Missing premise remains open; do not treat an unchanged object or old PASS as failure proof.

cases.symptom: Prior tail bareheaded, new first frame already helmeted; prompt only says fasten.
cases.root: design omission and wrong starting reference
cases.treatment: Plan allowed bareheaded/holding/putting-on/secured change; correct initial reference and motion path.
cases.acceptance: Actual join and transition show required starting and finishing states.
cases.stop: Stop cosmetic rewording while start design is wrong.

cases.symptom: Extra loose end appears; rope attached to moving door handle with clasp open.
cases.treatment: Identify both endpoints and the sole free end; distinguish fixed load-bearing structure from moving door.
cases.acceptance: Actual connection/closure and door movement preserve endpoint ownership; no duplication.
cases.stop: Ambiguous structural reference cannot be cleared by adding the word fixed.

cases.symptom: Door closed in near view, open again in next wide view, then closed again.
cases.treatment: Compare exact adjacent boundary files/time ranges and preserve one approved open-to-close event.
cases.acceptance: Actual seam chronology is consistent; anchor relation persists.
cases.stop: Do not use rejected whole clip as downstream reference.

cases.symptom: User replay reports stiff walking while still frame shows feet inside.
cases.treatment: Locate actual segment and foot/contact/weight sequence; simplify only with evidence and scope.
cases.acceptance: Continuous replay supports action completion and judged motion; frame metadata is not motion evidence.
cases.stop: Keep unknown without replay; do not promise frame-rate or speed cure.

cases.symptom: Only reference slots supplied, but text promises fixed first/last states.
cases.treatment: Inspect real current mode/fields and actual submission; choose supported control or smaller authorized unit.
cases.acceptance: Mode definition and submitted binding establish conditioning used; verify real output anyway.
cases.stop: Stop hard-endpoint promises when only reference control exists; no automatic task/fee expansion.

normal_controls: Established time jump or omitted already-supported preparation can be valid.
Shot/reverse-shot screen-side changes do not change anatomical handedness.
No-media text tasks continue with media explicitly unverified.
Correct endpoints do not prove correct intermediate action, and a verified motion does not fix wrong story premises.
